description: Somos uma equipe de estudantes do ensino médio técnico da Escola de Indústria FIRJAN SESI São Gonçalo, unidos pelo interesse em tecnologia, ciência e inovação. Acreditamos no trabalho colaborativo, na criatividade e na troca de conhecimentos para transformar ideias em soluções.
summary:
The project transforms hardware left by NASA in a captivating story. The main proposal is to transform those machines in characters that guide the public on their missions

Each equipment represents a new engineering approach made to gather knowledge about the Moon or Mars, the user discovers why the hardware was sent to its mission and what it contributed to space exploration.

The project’s distinguishing feature lies in its combination of narrative and scientific information: creativity serves as a gateway to knowledge, not as a substitute for it. 
Thus, the experience seeks to spark interest in science and engineering by showcasing the historical and scientific significance of various NASA hardware.
details:
WHAT IS OUR PROJECT?

Incredible Stories of NASA Space Equipment on the Moon and Mars is a digital storytelling project that tells the stories of the many pieces of equipment NASA has left on the Moon and Mars. Our project's main goal is to present this information in an accessible way through interactive language, engaging characters, and exciting images, helping children and adults understand the importance of each piece of equipment to science.

WHY IS IT RELEVANT?

The project's relevance comes from the fact that, even though all the information is publicly available, most people cannot understand it - either because the language is too complex or simply because they are not interested. Amazing Stories of NASA Space Equipment on the Moon and Mars aims to solve both problems by using simple language and combining it with compelling storytelling.

TARGET AUDIENCE AND STORY STRUCTURE

The target audience is children ages 5 to 12, and the stories are structured with this audience in mind. Each story uses an educational approach, following the equipment as it carries out its mission. At the end of every story, there is always:

  • A question to encourage readers to learn more.
  • A fun fact to help reinforce their new knowledge.
WHAT ARE THE STORIES ABOUT?

Our demo includes eight stories: four about equipment left on the Moon (Ranger 7, Surveyor 3, the Apollo 11 retroreflector, and the Apollo 12 seismometer) and four about hardware left on Mars (Sojourner, Viking 1, Spirit, and Opportunity).

WHAT TOOLS WHERE USED ON THE CREATION OF THE DEMO?

The entire project is made using Canva, the specific Canva tools that where used, aside from the basic slide creation tools, are:

  • Canva AI;
  • Background remover;
  • Hyperlinks between pages.
